caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a bonnet, positioned in profile with the opening facing left. The bonnet is primarily off-white or cream in color and features a detailed pattern of embroidery consisting of floral and leafy vine motifs in a pale blue or gray hue. The bonnet has a rounded and slightly elongated shape, with a seam running vertically along the side and back. The edge facing the viewer, which would frame the wearer’s face, is outlined with a faint pink or lavender trim. There are also two strings or ties, similarly colored, hanging down loosely at the bottom corner of the bonnet. The background of the drawing is plain and uncolored, and at the lower right, there is handwritten text that reads: “Federal Art Project WPA of Va. By: Edna Rex.”
title: Baby's Cap
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
